hero.label: Product Updates
hero.title: MediaClaw Changelog
hero.description: Track product releases, capability upgrades, and UX improvements to stay up to date with every iteration.

items.title: Markdown Export, Video Transcripts, and Image Text Extraction
items.description: Added Markdown export, video transcript extraction, image text extraction for image posts, and comment time fields in comment exports.
highlights: Added Markdown export, making it easier to save collected records into local knowledge bases such as Obsidian and continue organizing them for AI-assisted workflows.

Added video transcripts and image text extraction: video notes can extract transcripts, and image posts can extract text from attached images, so completed text can be copied, exported, or synced from collected records.
Comment data exports now include a comment time field, making it easier to review feedback chronologically and filter important comments or leads.

items.title: Keyword Public Opinion Scan and Welfare Center
items.description: Added keyword public opinion scan and the welfare center, with better large-batch sync, account monitoring, keyword analysis, and Douyin image-post collection stability.
highlights: Added keyword public opinion scan: scan content samples from a search page to understand trends, topic directions, sentiment risks, user needs, product signals, and action ideas.
Added the welfare center: users who complete channel surveys or product feedback tasks can receive membership time and credit rewards.
Sync and feedback are more stable: large-batch data sync is steadier, completed content is preserved as much as possible when issues happen, and failure reasons are easier to understand.
Account monitoring and keyword analysis are more stable: account monitoring now gives a scan summary even when no viral content is found, and keyword analysis works better with long content.
Douyin batch collection stability improved: image-post batch collection is steadier.

items.title: Competitor Account Finder, Diagnostics Copy, and Scraping Stability Updates
items.description: Added competitor account discovery and diagnostics copying, while improving Xiaohongshu suggestions, Douyin like filtering, search titles, comment collection, and failure traceability.
highlights: Added competitor account discovery on search pages: niche strategy workflows can identify repeatedly appearing high-performing accounts, enrich creator profile information, and generate recommendation reasons.
Added diagnostics copying from execution details, allowing sanitized operation logs and error details to be copied when scraping fails, counts are low, or sync behaves unexpectedly.
Fixed unstable Xiaohongshu suggestion collection by adapting to the new search page and AI search page, reducing missing, empty, or incorrectly parsed suggestions.
Fixed Douyin creator profile like filtering, search result title recognition, and comment collection gaps.
Improved diagnostics for low collection counts and added failure protection for batch sync to Lark.

items.title: Full Douyin Image-Post Scraping & Major Comment Collection Improvement
items.description: Added full scraping support for Douyin image posts including content, comments, leads, and attachments. Significantly improved comment collection success rate across image detail pages, video detail pages, and recommendation feeds.
highlights: Added Douyin image post scraping for content, comments, leads, and attachments, with optimized handling for image-type posts.

Significantly improved Douyin comment collection success rate by adapting to different page types — image detail pages, video detail pages, and recommendation feeds — fixing issues where comments were missing or empty.

items.title: Keyword Opportunity Analysis & Improved Keyword Strategy Workflow
items.description: Added keyword opportunity analysis on search pages for quick content heat and topic distribution assessment, improved transition from seed keyword to long-tail analysis, and fixed note recognition and CSV export issues.
highlights: Added keyword opportunity analysis: quickly assess content heat and topic distribution on search pages to identify the best content angles for a given keyword.
Improved the transition from seed keyword analysis to long-tail analysis for a smoother drill-down workflow.
Added first-install risk reminder to help users manage scraping frequency safely.
Fixed inaccurate Xiaohongshu note content recognition, improving note sync accuracy and reducing missing or misclassified content.
Fixed incomplete CSV export fields — full post body, audio/video links, and other fields are now included.

items.title: Douyin Attachment Downloads, Favorites/Likes Scraping & AI Rewrite
items.description: Added Douyin attachment downloads and favorites/likes scraping, Lark Base template AI rewriting, and improved monitoring schedule settings.
highlights: Added Douyin post attachment downloads for cover images, videos, and audio files.
Added favorites and likes tab scraping on Xiaohongshu and Douyin creator profile pages.
Added AI rewrite capability to Lark Base templates: deconstructs title formulas and content structure, rewrites from different angles, and derives follow-up topic ideas from comments.
Changed monitoring scan schedule to hourly time slots with a dropdown picker for more intuitive configuration.
Fixed Xiaohongshu video playback issue where some posts showed a black screen despite successful attachment downloads.

items.title: Creator Profile Filtering, Version Notifications, and Edge Compatibility
items.description: Added topic keyword filtering on creator profile note lists, version update notifications, and Microsoft Edge compatibility improvements.
highlights: Creator profile note lists now support filtering by content topic keywords, making target notes easier to locate.
Added version update notifications to remind users when a new version is available and guide them to release details.
Improved extension compatibility and user experience in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Continuous Scraping & Topic Insight Upgrade
items.description: Upgraded continuous scraping workflows and improved low-follower viral content filtering with AI topic insight.
highlights: Added continuous scraping with batch inputs for post URLs, creator profile URLs, and keywords.
Added low-follower viral post filtering on Douyin and Xiaohongshu search pages.
Added query suggestion expansion and AI topic sub-direction insights for Xiaohongshu and Douyin.
items.note: Please control collection volume and frequency to avoid triggering risk-control checks.

items.title: Douyin Batch Scraping, Monitoring Digest, and Monetization Release
items.description: Expanded Douyin batch scraping and comment-lead capabilities, while launching monitoring digests and referral monetization.
highlights: Added batch scraping for Douyin single video pages, creator profile pages, and keyword search pages.
Added Douyin batch comment collection for lead filtering.
Added Douyin and Xiaohongshu competitor monitoring with daily insight digests pushed to Lark and matched records written to monitoring tables.
Launched website purchase/renewal flow (currently Alipay only, WeChat support coming later).
Launched referral program: 30% first-order commission, 5% renewal commission, and 10% first-purchase discount for invitees.
items.note: Douyin batch scraping currently does not support downloading original image/video attachments.

items.title: Xiaohongshu Creator Profile Enrichment & Comment Lead Filtering
items.description: Connected post-to-creator profile enrichment and added comment lead filtering and export workflows.
highlights: Supported opening creator profiles from posts and collecting follower count, engagement metrics, and account attributes merged back into each post record.
Supported comment lead filtering: merge into post-level analysis or export as a standalone lead table (including profile URL and user ID).

items.title: Xiaohongshu Batch Backfill & Filtering Upgrade
items.description: Upgraded Xiaohongshu keyword and creator post backfill workflow, with new filtering by comment and save counts.
highlights: Supported batch detail backfill for creator posts and keyword post lists.
Added filtering by comment count and save count on keyword result pages.
